items.source: MariaDB Vector is part of MariaDB 11.7 and enables storing and searching over machine learning-generated embeddings. It provides efficient vector similarity search capabilities using vector indexes, supporting both cosine similarity and Euclidean distance metrics.
items.translation: MariaDB Vector 是 MariaDB 11.7 的一部分，支持对机器学习生成的嵌入（embeddings）进行存储和搜索。 它利用向量索引提供高效的向量相似性搜索功能，同时支持余弦相似度和欧几里得距离度量。

items.source:
The MariaDB Vector Store automatically calculates similarity scores for documents returned from similarity searches.
These scores provide a normalized measure of how closely each document matches your search query.
items.translation:
MariaDB Vector Store 会自动计算相似性搜索返回文档的相似度分数。
这些分数提供了每个文档与您的搜索查询匹配程度的归一化衡量标准。

items.source: This means that documents with smaller distances (more similar) will have higher scores, making the results more intuitive to interpret.
items.translation: 这意味着距离较小（更相似）的文档将获得更高的分数，从而使结果更易于直观理解。

items.source:
Search results are automatically ordered by similarity score in descending order (highest score first).
This ensures that the most relevant documents appear at the top of your results.
items.translation:
搜索结果将根据相似度得分自动按降序排列（最高分在前）。
这确保了最相关的文档出现在结果的顶部。

items.source: In addition to the similarity score, the raw distance value is still available in the document metadata:
items.translation: 除了相似度分数外，原始距离值仍可在文档元数据中获取：

items.source: This makes threshold values consistent and intuitive - higher values mean more restrictive searches that only return highly similar documents.
items.translation: 这使得阈值具有一致性和直观性——较高的数值意味着更严格的搜索，仅返回高度相似的文档。
